bio: Housed within the modern Domo20 hotel, perched in a panoramic location overlooking the Bay of Naples, this restaurant serves simple Mediterranean cuisine with a contemporary twist. Authentic flavours are combined with modern touches, resulting in fresh and elegant dishes. In summer, meals are served on the delightful Terrazza Vesù, the third-floor roof-top terrace, where the views of one of the most iconic bays in the world are breathtaking. Here, suspended between sea and sky, guests can dine under the stars or enjoy a sunset cocktail, immersed in a truly elegant and relaxing ambience....
